blurb: Never Enuff Fishing Fleet offers open boat fishing trips from Glen Cove, NY, and private fishing charters for 6–10 passengers from Worlds Fair Marina in Queens, NY. They target various fish species in season including striped bass, bluefish, and fluke. The fleet specializes in birthday parties, group fishing trips, and corporate events.
extraNote: Open boat trips depart from Glen Cove at 73 Garvies Point Road; private charters depart from Worlds Fair Marina, Queens, NY
